name: Camping Resort Zugspitze
beschreibung: The Camping Resort Zugspitze is located in Tirol, in the vicinity of the Zugspitzmassiv. The facility is geared toward accommodating motorhomes, caravans, and tents. It has modern sanitary facilities and a sales area for basic foodstuffs. The location provides access to an extensive network of hiking and cycling trails. In the winter months, the site serves as a starting point for ski tours and winter hikes.
